description: Helps you decide what partner program to run and how to start it: it takes your company, product, partner model, partner goal and deal size, and returns a partner program with tiers, example commission amounts and KPIs. The structure differs for resellers, referrals, integrations, agencies, affiliates and white label, uses your existing partners when given, and names the partner types that fit your sector's buying committee. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of launch_commander when you need a partner program with tiers, commissions and KPIs.

business_model.description: Optional: how you earn revenue, so the advice fits it (saas, services, connectivity, transactions, marketplace, hardware_software or investment). Leave it out and the tool reads it from your other inputs and says how it read it. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

company.description: Your company name. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

existing_partners.description: Optional: Current partner types/count, one per line or separated by semicolons (listed in the plan). Format is text. For example, "regional implementation partners".

industry.description: Optional: your own company's sector, so the answer uses the usual buyers, measures and objections for what you sell. Leave it out and the tool reads the sector from your other inputs and names what it read. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

partner_goals.description: Revenue/growth targets from partners (shown as the target of the first KPI row). Format is text. For example, "recruit three implementation partners in six months".

partner_model.description: Partner type determines program structure. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "reseller".

partner_support_capacity.description: How much partner support can you provide? Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "minimal_self_serve".

product.description: Product partners will sell/integrate. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

your_deal_size.description: Average deal size as one amount (e.g., '$5000 ACV', '$5K' or '$500/month'; a range is refused). It scales the example commission amounts; the example rates are fixed. Format is text.

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".
